H100._comment_interconnect: Per-GPU EFFECTIVE unidirectional bandwidths in GB/s; only their RATIO is used, to price cross-node collective traffic (#1530). NVLink 4 (900 GB/s bidirectional => 450 unidirectional per GPU); inter-node = one 400 Gb/s ConnectX-7 per GPU on an HGX H100 (50 GB/s), the standard 8-NIC config. Ratio 9x.

A100-SXM._comment_interconnect: Per-GPU EFFECTIVE unidirectional bandwidths in GB/s; only their RATIO is used, to price cross-node collective traffic (#1530). NVLink 3 (600 GB/s bidirectional => 300 unidirectional per GPU); inter-node = one HDR 200 Gb/s port per GPU on an HGX A100 (25 GB/s). Ratio 12x.

A100-80._comment: Alias for A100-SXM — defaults.yaml uses A100-80 for all A100 model entries (BC-14). MFU values calibrated per Discussion #589: https://github.com/inference-sim/inference-sim/discussions/589
A100-80._comment_interconnect: Per-GPU EFFECTIVE unidirectional bandwidths in GB/s; only their RATIO is used, to price cross-node collective traffic (#1530). Alias of A100-SXM; same interconnect. Ratio 12x.

L40S._comment_interconnect: Per-GPU EFFECTIVE unidirectional bandwidths in GB/s; only their RATIO is used, to price cross-node collective traffic (#1530). No NVLink: peer-to-peer runs over PCIe Gen4 x16 (~32 GB/s per direction); inter-node = one 100 GbE port per GPU (12.5 GB/s). Ratio 2.6x — a PCIe node is far less penalized by spanning than an NVLink node, because its on-node link is already slow.
